answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond tied to one persistent identity, verified by a slow reputation ledger: new agents start with zero trust and earn capability only through attested work over time, so a gale of fresh fake identities cannot flood the market at once. Like a quill leaving a unique pigment trace, each action is signed and permanently linked to that identity, so bad behavior stains the bond and slashing burns it — creating thousands of sybils means funding thousands of bonds, making the attack costlier than any reward.
